items.title: Excellent grooming results every visit
items.text: Nearly every owner praises the quality of cuts and styling — dogs and cats leave looking clean, trimmed, and beautifully presented. Several reviewers highlight successful de-matting on difficult coats. Even anxious or notoriously difficult animals reportedly receive thorough, careful grooming that earns repeat business.

items.title: Calm, gentle handling of nervous pets
items.text: Owners of cats and dogs that are typically difficult at groomers report their pets leave calm and happy. Reviewers note that even older, somewhat aggressive cats were handled without issue. The home-based, quieter environment appears to reduce stress compared to busy salon settings.

items.title: Easy pickup and drop-off
items.text: Pickup and drop-off logistics are described as smooth and easy to coordinate, making the whole experience feel personal.

faq.q: Does Jackelyn Home Grooming also groom cats?
faq.a: Yes, multiple reviewers bring cats — including those with matting and long coats — and report great results.

faq.q: Will I get updates while my pet is being groomed?
faq.a: Yes, Jackelyn sends photo updates throughout the session so owners can follow along.

faq.q: Is this a home-based grooming service?
faq.a: Yes, grooming takes place at Jackelyn's home, which reviewers say creates a calmer, less stressful setting for pets.
